Japan's **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** (period 2026-05-01). It ranks **32nd of 121** countries.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the working-age population. At 1.0, usage matches population exactly, so Japan uses Claude about 1.9 times as much as its population alone would predict.

Some other figures, with the global average in brackets:
- **Use case:** 47% work (43%), 47% personal (40%), 6% coursework (16%)
- **How Claude is used:** 53% augmentation, meaning working with Claude on a task (51%), and 47% automation, meaning handing the task off (49%)

Source: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
